name: Koumoto Machi
source:
Currently six months unemployed, Machi once worked for a prestigious corporation. As if hated by fortune, Machi’s misery was further compounded by the sudden departure of her boyfriend and the gradual reduction of unemployment compensation. The emotional shock of these events has all but devastated the woman’s frail mindset and self esteem.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120320235028/http://www.erogereview.com/2011/06/07/gokuin-no-sentou//]Nargrakhan's review[/url].]
